canonical_name: Vizing edge-coloring theorem family for finite loopless graphs
literal_source_claim_en: The edge chromatic number of a graph.
statement_blocker: The catalog gives only an edge-chromatic-number topic gloss. The inspected secondary source states both the finite loopless-multigraph bound Delta <= chi' <= Delta + mu and its finite-simple-graph specialization Delta <= chi' <= Delta + 1, but the 1964 primary paper was not inspected and the catalog does not choose a variant. The statement phase must source-approve that choice and freeze graph/multiplicity representation, finiteness, edge adjacency, proper coloring, chromatic-index minimum versus coloring existence, line-graph transport, maximum degree, lower-bound composition, binders, typeclasses, imports, and boundary cases.
target_decision: preserve the full source-backed Vizing edge-coloring family without silently narrowing the loopless-multigraph theorem to mathlib SimpleGraph; require primary-source acceptance and an explicit root/specialization decision in the statement phase
domain_and_universes: Open: an accepted statement must choose a finite loopless multigraph or finite simple graph, fix vertex and edge universes, parallel-edge representation, finiteness and decidability presentation, and line-graph or direct edge-coloring encoding.
conclusion: Open formal encoding of the source-selected Vizing bound: the loopless-multigraph inequality Delta(G) <= chi'(G) <= Delta(G) + mu(G), or its explicitly justified finite-simple-graph specialization Delta(G) <= chi'(G) <= Delta(G) + 1.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before the exact proposition is frozen; the statement phase must resolve every case listed in scope-map.md without silently adding source-external hypotheses.
candidate_scope_not_credited: the general finite loopless-multigraph bound Delta(G) <= chi'(G) <= Delta(G) + mu(G)
the finite-simple-graph specialization Delta(G) <= chi'(G) <= Delta(G) + 1
the upper-bound existence formulation that a finite simple graph has a proper edge coloring with Delta(G) + 1 colors
a numerical line-graph chromatic-number conjunction including both lower and upper bounds
degenerate_cases_to_resolve: empty vertex type and edgeless nonempty graphs
one edge, matchings, paths, stars, and disconnected graphs with isolated vertices
odd and even cycles and complete graphs attaining either bound
maximum degree zero and palette size one
parallel-edge bundles and multiplicity zero or one if the multigraph theorem is selected
loop exclusion and whether finite/decidable typeclasses add unintended premises
excluded_substitutions: Konig's equality of chromatic index and maximum degree only for bipartite graphs
Vizing's planar class-one theorem or adjacency lemma
only the elementary lower bound Delta <= chi' when the source root includes the upper bound
an arbitrary EdgeLabeling without the properness condition for incident edges
a structure or hypothesis that stores the desired coloring conclusion
finite computations, the untrusted catalog label 已验证, or the API probe as source or proof credit
